manifest.holdoutDefinition: closed candles strictly after discoveryCutoff; never used for candidate selection

parity.simulator: runtime opportunity id + level/lifecycle dedupe; review previous closed candle before current signal evaluation; same-symbol concurrent opportunities retained; no cooldown; shared no-chase rule

lifecycleParity.method: Candidate-specific research lifecycle is advanced on each prior closed candle; hard SL/TP, invalidated_exit, and time_stop_exit are all settled before the next opportunity dedupe decision. Production review engine is unchanged.

decision.caveat: This is an attribution heuristic, not a causal claim; early-invalidation and time-stop candidates are compared separately.

scoreCalibration.note: Deciles are descriptive; no minimum-score optimization was performed.

repeatedSignalAttribution.clusterRule: same symbol + direction + signalType/opportunity family, consecutive signal timestamps within the window; first/second/third+ labels
